_about: THE conversion rubric: how a Bad Eden mechanic written for RFI (the fourththing system) becomes its D&D 5E (dnd5e 6) twin. Read by tools/build-packs.mjs (the lint), bin/ft-convert-5e (the converter) and bin/ft-lint-parity (the parity check). Rendered for humans as CONVERSION_RUBRIC.md — keep the two in step. Every entry marked ruling:true was ruled by Dave; ruling:'owed' is a draft awaiting one.

sourceOfTruth.rule: Mechanics are authored ONCE. Anything shared by both flavours is authored in RFI canon (bbttcc-master-content/packs/_source + the fourththing engine banks) and flows through the converter into modules/bad-eden-5e/content/. Content that exists only in D&D (the SW5E-derived classes and powers) is authored in content/ and marked origin: 5e.
sourceOfTruth.link: every converted document carries flags.bad-eden-5e.rfi = { id: <source _id>, pack: <source pack>, hash: <rubric-output hash> } so the parity lint can tell missing / stale / orphaned

square.note: 1 square = 5 ft; '6 squares' → 30 ft; 'within 2 squares' → within 10 ft

scene.note: '1/Scene' and 'per scene' — a scene ≈ an encounter; short rest is the nearest 5E window

tier-uses.text: a number of uses equal to your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest

per-campaign-start.note: faction resource grants (Strategic Hooks) run in both flavours

small bonus / +1 rank (no rule behind it.note: Dave 2026-10-07: keep (+1d4 where the source rolls a die, e.g. Coalition Tongue)

stress points.to: 1d4 psychic damage when it bites; temp HP equal to your proficiency bonus when it heals

clarity.to: keep the word; a Clarity bonus becomes a points bonus on every tradition the actor casts (ae flags.bad-eden-5e.bonus.points ADD n, n = the Clarity amount)
clarity.scale: Clarity is a 5-ish pool, Flow points are 4×level — see conditions.scarred for the bite scale

radiation.to: keep — bbttcc-radiation runs in both flavours; NOT a dnd5e damage type

defense check vs X.to: a saving throw of the mapped ability (see abilities); poison / disease / environmental → Constitution

your DC.to: 8 + your proficiency bonus + the feature's ability modifier (the ancestry lean, or the casting ability)

abilities._lineageLean: 'Lineage Lean toward X' → 'Ancestry Lean: <ability>' — no fixed score bonus in either flavour (backgrounds carry the increases)

ranks.gain a skill rank: proficiency; if already proficient → expertise; if already expert → Mastery

mastery.text: Mastery: on checks with that skill or tool, treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10

reroll-lowest.note: unconditional → AE; conditional ('vs poison', 'while unmoved') → text

3d10 keep lowest 2 / Imposed.to: disadvantage on the target's next attack roll or saving throw

banked reroll (_tq.bank).to: banked advantage: the next d20 roll you make (or hand to an ally) has advantage
banked reroll (_tq.bank).note: automation is a follow-up; text first

exploding d10.to: keep as a stated rule: 'on a 10, roll again and add'

minimum roll threshold.to: treat any 1 on the die as a 2

tiers.tierForLevel: 1–4 → I, 5–10 → II, 11–16 → III, 17+ → IV (RFI's own ladder; D&D's tiers of play)

radiation.to: the radiation ladder (bbttcc-radiation), never a damage type; 'radiation damage' in text → 'radiation exposure (one step on the ladder)'

energy (legacy, by flavor).to: the flavor's D&D type: lightning / fire / cold

true.to: damage that can't be reduced or prevented

staggered.to: status be5e-staggered (scripts/riders.js) + speed ×½, −2 to attack rolls — the same Active Effect on the creature lane and the manifestation (spell) lane
staggered._why: C42 2026-10-31: six Stagger spells shipped an empty effect

scarred.to: keep the mark; the Clarity bite scales to the Flow pool: −1 Flow point per 5 points of your Flow maximum (minimum 1) until the end of the scene
scarred._why: ruled 2026-10-07 (Dave took the proportional proposal): Clarity ≈ a 5-point pool, so −1 Clarity ≈ 20% of the pool

calmed.to: charmed (with the RFI wording: can't take violent action willingly)

burning.to: 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to put it out

compelled.to: charmed, and it must spend at least one action each turn on the directive

dying.to: 0 hit points and death saving throws

surprised.to: surprised (can't act on the first round)

imposed.to: disadvantage on its next attack roll or saving throw

submerged / drowning / crushing.to: the 5E underwater and suffocation rules; crushing → 1d4 bludgeoning per turn unrated

jolted (SW5E shocked).to: can't take reactions until the start of its next turn

effects._about: what each RFI engine effect kind becomes on the 5E side. 'ae' = a transfer Active Effect on the feature; 'activity' = a dnd5e activity; 'text' = prose only; 'rider' = flags.bad-eden-5e.riders consumed by scripts/riders.js (bank, impose, strain) — the techniques rider pass shipped 2026-10-07

rerolls[].to: unconditional (no vs/when) → advantage AE per rolls.reroll-lowest.ae; initiative → system.attributes.init.roll.mode ADD 1; conditional → text

grants.resistances[].flavor: a flavored entry ('energy'+'fire') maps through damage

grants.skills / ITEM_APTITUDE_GRANTS.to: proficiency via a Trait advancement (skills:<key> / tool:<key>); 'choice' → a Trait choice

discipline.passive / discipline.mode.gra.clarityMaxBonus n: ae flags.bad-eden-5e.bonus.points ADD n — every tradition the actor casts
discipline.passive / discipline.mode.gra.concurrencyBonus n: ae system.attributes.concentration.limit ADD n — one more concentration
discipline.passive / discipline.mode.gra.upkeepScale ≤ 0.5: ae system.attributes.concentration.roll.mode ADD 1 — advantage on concentration saves
discipline.passive / discipline.mode.gra.reachDiscount n: ae flags.bad-eden-5e.discount.upcast ADD n — each upcast step costs n less, never below the base cost
discipline.passive / discipline.mode.gra.misfireBandShift: text — 5E casting has no misfire table (the Instability Table is a random-effects draw, not a severity ladder)
discipline.passive / discipline.mode.gra.mode {key, grants}: a SECOND effect, disabled by default, named '<Technique> — <stance> held', flags.bad-eden-5e.mode = key; the player toggles it while the stance is held; pkSealedPact flips automatically with the surge-powers 'Sealed Pact' buff (scripts/disciplines.js MODE_STANCES)
discipline.passive / discipline.mode.gra._why: ruled 2026-10-07 by Dave in the Paths doc: all five mappings approved as proposed

Clarity techniques.Frugal Caster: ae flags.bad-eden-5e.discount.level1 ADD 1 — level-1 powers cost 1 less (min 0)
Clarity techniques.Reclamation: riders strain 1 + restore {per5: 2, min: 2} once per short rest — 2 points back per 5 of the pool max, in every tradition cast

triggers[] (chat-prompt).to: text — the prompt body is already the rule

resourceGrants[] (OP).to: text, verbatim, as a 'Strategic Hooks' feature — the faction layer runs in both flavours

_tq.temp(n).to: heal activity, healType temphp, formula per scalars

_tq.impose.to: disadvantage on the target's next attack roll or saving throw (text; rider later)

gear._about: RFI item → dnd5e item (the gear lane; drafted, not yet run)

weapon.damage.formula: dnd5e damage part (dice + bonus); '+N' flat bonuses are dropped unless the item is enhanced
weapon.intent: the item's Intent (any of six faculties; weapons default violence) is its attack AND damage faculty — violence → Str melee / Dex finesse; intrigue → Dex ranged. system.damage.attribute is retired (2026-11-08) and ignored
weapon.category melee/ranged: weapon type simpleM/martialM/simpleR/martialR: martial = tagged heavy, two-handed, reach, or a firearm beyond a pistol; everything else simple (ruled 2026-10-07)

keep as a Bad Eden property in text

weapon.manifestation.tier: rarity: 1 uncommon, 2 rare, 3 very rare, 4 legendary

guardBonus.to: AC = 10 + guardBonus for light, 12 + bonus for medium, 14 + bonus for heavy — band by armorSkill/tags

evasionBonus.to: Dex save bonus AE (abilities.dex.bonuses.save), carried at full value

resolveBonus.to: Wis save bonus AE (abilities.wis.bonuses.save), carried at full value — +3..+5 on the legendary vestments STAND (ruled 2026-10-07)

armor.armorSkill: fitting → light, plating → medium/heavy, bracing → shield (ruled)

gear / equipment / consumable.type: loot | tool | consumable by category; 'potion' → consumable potion

price.marks: keep marks (both flavours); dnd5e price field = marks with denomination 'gp' labelled marks

consumables._about: C46 ruled 2026-10-31: the RFI 'On use: …; Charges: N' block becomes real dnd5e activities where the rubric can express the op; every activity spends one use, Charges → uses.max, autoDestroy at 0
consumables.Restore / Reduce N Stress: heal activity, temporary hit points = @prof (the Stress-points ruling)
consumables.Inflict N Stress: damage activity on yourself, Nd4 psychic
consumables.Cure <condition>: utility activity + flags.bad-eden-5e.cure [dnd5e status]; the chat line says which condition ends (runtime hook owed: scripts/ reads the flag and removes the status)
consumables.Restore N Clarity: utility activity + flags.bad-eden-5e.flow N (Clarity = Flow points)
consumables.Noise · Radiation · Surge · FrameDice ·: utility activity whose chat line names the op for the GM — no D&D engine yet; listed in _needs-human/gear.md

wondrous.to: an unconditional 'resistance to X' in the text → a transfer Active Effect on traits.dr; every other promised mechanic stays honest prose and is listed in _needs-human/gear.md for an override (C46 ruled 2026-10-31)

gear.flags.bbttcc: carried verbatim on every gear twin and part of the parity hash (hazardResist / radiation.tierDelta / radiationResist / darkness*: api.radiation protectionFor and the darkness engine read it on either system) — C64 2026-10-31

creatures._about: RFI NPC/monster → dnd5e npc (the monster lane). Source = packs/_source/npcs (lineage-flagged actors, items embedded) — C40 2026-10-31; conversion/sources/npcs-monsters.jsonl is a fallback only. Numbers: hp = Integrity, AC = Guard, CR DERIVED from them (DMG p.274 defensive/offensive average) so the label matches the sheet — C45 ruled 2026-10-31; the tier×bracket band is now only the needs-row comparison. Chassis (threat-chassis.js) still sets strikes, legendary actions and the per-tier damage bonus.
creatures.integrity.max: hp.max (verbatim — no chassis pool multiplier; C45 2026-10-31)
creatures.lineage / creatureType: dnd5e creature type (humanoid, construct, fey, fiend, celestial, beast, monstrosity, aberration)
creatures.npcAuto rules: activities + AEs; what can't be modelled → feature text

cr.to: derived from hp / AC / damage-per-round / attack bonus (DMG table, CR_ROWS in convert-5e.mjs); needs-row when it sits >2 off the Tier×bracket band
cr._why: ruled 2026-10-31 (C45): the number the GM sees must match the stat block

creatures.power saves: the intent's own save: Violence Str · Intrigue Dex · Body Con · Mind Int · Soul Wis · Presence Cha (C48 2026-10-31; no fold to Wisdom)
creatures.defense lists: condition words in resistances/immunities (fear, charm, …) → traits.ci (frightened, charmed, …), never a damage type (C47 2026-10-31)
creatures.prose: the RFI stat idiom (Strike./Working. labels, 'reach 1 square., one target.', 'Damage: 2d10 kinetic + violence', 'Hit: … + violence; half on success', 'Fail: <dice> type + Condition', 'Cost. 2 Clarity, +2 Noise', 'Damage goes to Stress') is stripped before the rubric runs — the activity carries the dice; the rider sentence and Dave's flavour line stay (C43 2026-10-31)

surge._why: Surge repricing 2026-11-12 (RFI _FT_SURGE_MENU) mirrored 2026-11-13. Surge stays a shared engine (no converter lane): the D&D twin is the surge-powers menu + data/paths.json and the dnd5e-table-kit riders, edited by hand against this table.
surge.tier: every Tier-scaled Surge effect → the proficiency bonus (Dave 2026-11-13: "when I say proficiency bonus I mean in the BadEden5E system. In RFI it's Tier level.")
surge.gate: an RFI Tier gate → minProf: Tier I → none (PB 2) · Tier II → 3 · Tier III → 4 · Tier IV → 6; cost cap by gate 4 / 6 / 8 / 10

heals.universal: Stitch / Field Patch → 2d6 × PB · Rallying Cry → 1d6 × PB (each ally)
heals.path: by the 5E price: 1 → 1d6 × PB · 2–3 → 2d6 × PB · 4+ → 3d6 × PB; an area heal → 1d6 × PB each; a doctrine that 'heals more' keeps its + PB on top
heals.formula: dnd5e roll string 'Nd6*@prof' (the multiplier applies to the dice total)

damage.+Tier to hit and damage (Tier Surge): Power Surge: +PB to the attack roll and +PB damage
damage.critical ×2 (Crowning Blow): auto-hit, dnd5e critical with every die maximised
damage.Final Argument: auto-hit critical, +PB d6, every die maximised, ignores resistance
damage.riders wait for a hit: native in dnd5e: damage one-shots are consumed by the damage roll, which only follows a hit

vocabulary._about: text substitutions the converter applies before a human sees the draft, and the terms the lint refuses to ship
replace: against your save DC (8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier)
Roll the damage twice and keep the lower result
you gain expertise with it instead
\bImpose the target: its next attack roll is 3d10 keep-lowest-2\b
the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll
give \1 disadvantage on its next attack roll or saving throw
vocabulary.squares: (\d+) squares? → N×5 feet (handled by the converter, not a plain substitution)
vocabulary.bannedFlags: i for the case-insensitive ones is decided by the tool: everything in banned is tested case-insensitively except the capitalised proper terms (Integrity, Violence…, VIO…)
keep: Steward? → character (RFI's word for a PC)

tokens.@ABILITY: the faculty in the match, through abilities (full name)
tokens.@SKILL: the skill in the match, through skills (full name)
tokens.@SAVE: Resolve → Wisdom, Evasion → Dexterity, Guard → (AC; no save)

vocabulary._order: front: grammatical reroll/rank rows · middle: the mechanics table · tail: bare capitalised faculty names (Violence→Strength …) so phrases like 'Presence (Persuasion) check' and 'Violence or Dexterity' resolve
vocabulary.lintScope: docs carrying flags.bad-eden-5e.rfi (RFI-origin) are linted for RFI vocabulary only; the Star Wars list applies to origin:5e content (classes, subclasses, powers) — a Bad Eden blaster is a Bad Eden blaster
vocabulary._opToMarks: rows '\10 marks' append a 0: 1 OP = 10 marks (rfi-pricing authority; the RFI ancestry cards say '+20 Intrigue marks') — OP is a name, quantities are marks (marks-everywhere, C72 2026-10-31)

_rulings.2026-10-07: Dave ruled rubric lines 1–8 (small bonus +2, Stress points, Clarity/Noise kept with Flow-point bonus, radiation stays a ladder, the skill table, armor bands, martial weapons, marks, creature scores 10+2×value). Scarred's scale is the one open question.
_rulings.2026-10-07b: Dave ruled Scarred = −1 Flow point per 5 of Flow max (min 1) and that the big Resolve/Evasion save bonuses on legendary vestments stand in 5E. Cross-tradition casting (Flow-Touched / Crossed Wires / Wired for Both) automated in the engine (castThrough).
_rulings.2026-10-07c: PROPOSED (built, awaiting Dave): the nine Path-discipline techniques and the Clarity techniques → Active Effects / riders per engine.discipline.* and engine['Clarity techniques']; needs-human for techniques fell 31 → 6.
_rulings.2026-10-07d: Dave APPROVED all five discipline/Clarity mappings (Paths doc, 'Rulings owed'). Martial subclass names ruled: Leyline Runner, Circuit Sarge (Fighter); Rhapsodist, Wheelstick (Rogue); Warrior of the Wire keeps its name with the nickname Wireior; the Furies and the Riptide stand.
_rulings.2026-10-30: Archetype prose pass: skill names after 'proficiency in' map through the skill table (Faith→Religion, Lore→History, Occult→Arcana, Diplomacy→Persuasion, Empathy→Insight); bare Violence/Intrigue stay as Domain mark pools when the sentence is about marks. 'the X aptitude' → the skill/tool through the skill table (Tinkering → tinker's tools, Occult → Arcana).
_rulings.2026-10-31: Dave: Piloting is a Bad Eden 5E skill (Dex, key pil); Firearms is a weapon category (firearmR / proficiency fir), not a skill — martial classes + Warden/Vigilant proficient. The Chariot and The Fool swap Perception for Piloting.
_rulings.2026-11-13: Dave: Surge heals = 2d6 × proficiency bonus in Bad Eden 5E (Rallying Cry / area 1d6 × PB; class heals by price 1 → 1d6, 2–3 → 2d6, 4+ → 3d6 × PB); every Tier-scaled Surge effect uses PB. The 2026-11-12 menu prices mirror onto the surge-powers universal menu at the same keys (Tier Surge → Power Surge).

damage-only harm.to: never auto-hits: 'vs Evasion' in the RFI sentence → a ranged spell attack (melee on touch); otherwise a saving throw — the named defense, else Dexterity for Integrity-track damage, Wisdom for Stress-track — half damage on a success; the −2 AC / −2 saves rider lands only on a hit or a failed save
